zeta-2026-مترجم-اون-لاين.title: Zeta
zeta-2026-مترجم-اون-لاين.synopsis: يُغتال أربعة ضباط مخابرات إسبان سابقين في وقت واحد حول العالم. ويكتشف جهاز المخابرات الوطني أنهم جميعاً شاركوا في عملية سيناغا السرّية قبل عقود في كولومبيا. زيتا، أفضل عميل في الجهاز، مُكلّف بمطاردة الناجي الوحيد وحمايته، ليواجه بذلك أخطر مهمة عالمية في مسيرته. ينضم إليه العميلة الكولومبية البارزة ألفا، التي يبدو أنها أكثر دراية بأسرار سيناغا منه.

ابنتي.title: ابنتي
ابنتي.synopsis:
أويكو، الطفلة ذات الثماني سنوات، فتاة استثنائية تتمتع بقدر عالٍ من التعاطف والإدراك لما حولها، على عكس أقرانها. عندما تتخلى عنها عمتها التي كانت ترعاها منذ ولادتها، تضطر أويكو للبحث عن والدها ديمير.

لكن ديمير، وهو شخص غير مسؤول ومحتال نشأ في دار للأيتام، يُعتقل في اليوم نفسه الذي تأتي فيه أويكو للعثور عليه. يتم الإفراج عنه بقرار من المحكمة بشرط أن يتولى رعاية ابنته، إلا أنه لا يرغب في العيش مع الطفلة التي التقاها حديثًا.

يحاول ديمير وشريكه في الجريمة أوغور التخلص من أويكو أثناء تحضيرهما لعملية كبيرة. أما هدفهما كاندان، فتعيش حياة تبدو هادئة لكنها تخفي خلفها ماضيًا مؤلمًا.

ستجمع الصدفة هؤلاء الأشخاص معًا، دون أن يدرك أحد أن لدى أويكو سرًا لا تستطيع إخبار أحد به.

vietnam-the-war-that-changed-america.title: Vietnam: The War That Changed America
vietnam-the-war-that-changed-america.titleEn: Vietnam: The War That Changed America
vietnam-the-war-that-changed-america.originalTitle: Vietnam: The War That Changed America
vietnam-the-war-that-changed-america.synopsis: بمزيج من الشهادات الشخصية والمشاهد الآسرة، يروي هذا المسلسل الوثائقي القصص الإنسانية المذهلة والفردية والعميقة لمن عاشوا في فترة الحرب، ويستكشف كيف تغيّرت "أمريكا" في أعقابها.

prodigal-son.title: Prodigal Son
prodigal-son.synopsis: مسلسل تحقيقات تدور أحداثه حول (مالكوم برايت) أحد أمهر علماء النفس الجنائيين، الذي يساعد شرطة “نيويورك” لحل الجرائم والقبض على القتلة والمجرمين مستخدمًا عبقريته وخبرته مع والده القاتل المتسلسل المعروف باسم “الجراح”.

cada-minuto-cuenta.title: Cada Minuto Cuenta
cada-minuto-cuenta.synopsis: في 19 سبتمبر 1985، ضرب زلزال بقوة 8.1 درجة مدينة "مكسيكو سيتي"، متسبباً في واحدة من أكبر مآسي البلد. وخلال الساعات الأولى من الكارثة، أصبح طبيب وممرضاته أبطالاً غير متوقعين إذ عملوا بلا كلل لإنقاذ العالقين تحت المشفى العام. كما كانت هناك صحفية تنقل أخبار الكارثة بينما تجوب المدينة وعائلة تحاول لمّ شملها وسط الأنقاض.

last-days-of-the-space-age.title: Last Days of the Space Age
last-days-of-the-space-age.titleEn: Last Days of the Space Age
last-days-of-the-space-age.originalTitle: Last Days of the Space Age

succession.synopsis: تدور الأحداث حول عائلة تمتلك شركة إعلامية كبيرة جدًا، لكن هذه العائلة بها الكثير من الاختلال بين أفرادها، حتى أنهم لديهم صراعات داخلية، بسبب طموحات البعض الخاصة وبسبب الميول الغريبة لدى البعض الآخر، وهو ما يمكن القول معه أنها عائلة إعلامية مختلة.

يعني-لك-meant-for-you-2025.title: Meant For You
يعني-لك-meant-for-you-2025.synopsis: Lawyer Tuğçe is unexpectedly left by her boyfriend Furkan. Struggling at work, she agrees to help her troubled client Erdem in exchange for rekindling her relationship with Furkan. Plans go awry, but as Tuğçe and Erdem get to know each other, she discovers true love in Erdem's arms.

check-in-2026.title: Check-In
check-in-2026.synopsis: VMX hottest star Aliya Raymundo teams up with sexy siren Anya Austria as two receptionists in a cheap motel. Their quiet routine heats up with the arrival of a mysterious regular guest who begins to stir tension, desire, and conflict in their fragile relationship.

even-if-this-love-disappears-tonight-202.title: Even If This Love Disappears Tonight
even-if-this-love-disappears-tonight-202.titleEn: Even If This Love Disappears Tonight
even-if-this-love-disappears-tonight-202.originalTitle: Even If This Love Disappears Tonight 2025
even-if-this-love-disappears-tonight-202.synopsis: تستيقظ فتاة في المدرسة الثانوية كل يوم من دون أن تتذكر ما جرى في الأمس، لكن حين توافق على مواعدة زميلها الخجول، هل يمكن أن يكبر حبهما مع كل بداية جديدة؟

singsot-2025.title: Singsot
singsot-2025.synopsis: A kid defies the ancient taboo of whistling at dusk, unleashing a sinister terror tied to a cursed figure who made the same mistake. Bound by an inescapable curse, he’s thrust into a deadly race against time—because if he fails, the nightmare will become his new reality.

bodyguard-3-2025.title: Bodyguard 3
bodyguard-3-2025.synopsis: The film tells the story of the newcomer bodyguard Gao Tian, who, in order to rescue his kidnapped fiancée, is accidentally involved in an undercover operation to investigate a criminal group. With the cooperation of Gao Tian and the police's undercover falcon, he has gone through all kinds of difficulties and risks, and finally succeeded in rescuing his fiancée and bringing all the criminals to justice.

memoir-of-a-murderer-2017.title: Memoir of a Murderer
memoir-of-a-murderer-2017.synopsis: قاتل متسلسل سابق مصاب بمرض الزهايمر يكافح لحماية ابنته من حبيبها الغامض الذي قد يكون قاتلاً متسلسلاً أيضاً.

sakaratul-maut-2024.title: Sakaratul Maut
sakaratul-maut-2024.synopsis: At a time when Pak Wiryo found it difficult to die because he had a 'hold', the children of his first wife and second wife were fighting over the inheritance.

dog-days-2024.title: Dog Days
dog-days-2024.synopsis: Adele struggles with confidence in her body. When she’s challenged by a group of kids during an afternoon at the swimming pool, Adele is forced to confront her insecurities and decide whether she will fit in or not.

good-person-2021.title: Good Person
good-person-2021.synopsis: High school teacher Gyeongseok agrees to look after his daughter Yunhui for his ex-wife’s sudden request. He brings Yunhui with him to the school where he works. There, he leaves Yunhui alone in the car briefly, and when he returns she’s gone. Later, Yunhui is found after having been grievously injured in a car accident. The driver of the truck that hit her, however, indicates that Seik, one of Gyeongseok’s students, was the true cause of the accident.

ustaad-bhagat-singh-2026.title: Ustaad Bhagat Singh
ustaad-bhagat-singh-2026.synopsis: A tribal boy is shaped by the values of his teacher, who gives him the name 'Bhagat Singh'. He grows up deeply rooted in strong morals, which guide his actions throughout his life.He stands firm against injustice and takes on powerful evil forces, even when facing overwhelming odds.

mirage-2025.title: Mirage
mirage-2025.synopsis: A young man observes a chaotic fight outside a rural California gas station and makes a decision.

junior-2025.title: Junior
junior-2025.synopsis: A college freshman joins his school’s Filipino club, only to discover that they’re specifically looking for good dancers.

rode-college-2024.title: Rode College
rode-college-2024.synopsis: Based on the lives and activities of the students at a prestige college.

gamblers-2025.title: Gamblers
gamblers-2025.synopsis: Players gather at a hidden casino to compete for a 100 crore prize. As they play, their secret agendas surface, transforming the game into a lethal competition.

hisaab-barabar-2024.title: Hisaab Barabar
hisaab-barabar-2024.synopsis: Radhe Mohan, an honest TC working for Indian Railways and a self-proclaimed accounts expert, sets out to uncover a massive financial fraud by banker Mickey Mehta. As Mickey puts the entire system against Radhe, what lies next for him?

bobby-aur-rishi-ki-love-story-2025.title: Bobby Aur Rishi Ki Love Story
bobby-aur-rishi-ki-love-story-2025.titleEn: Bobby Aur Rishi Ki Love Story
bobby-aur-rishi-ki-love-story-2025.originalTitle: Bobby Aur Rishi Ki Love Story 2025
bobby-aur-rishi-ki-love-story-2025.synopsis: Set against the picturesque backdrop of Cambridge, the film follows the journey of Bobby and Rishi as they going through the complexities of love and life. The story revolves around their passionate romance, which faces numerous challenges and misunderstandings. Despite being separated by circumstances, their love remains strong. Years later, fate gives them a second chance to rekindle their relationship and overcome the obstacles that once tore them apart.

rocky-aur-rani-kii-prem-kahaani-2023.title: Rocky Aur Rani Kii Prem Kahaani
rocky-aur-rani-kii-prem-kahaani-2023.titleEn: Rocky Aur Rani Kii Prem Kahaani
rocky-aur-rani-kii-prem-kahaani-2023.originalTitle: Rocky Aur Rani Kii Prem Kahaani 2023
rocky-aur-rani-kii-prem-kahaani-2023.synopsis: Gym-freak brat Rocky falls in love with Rani, who comes from a well-educated Bengali family. Being from polar opposite worlds, the two decide to switch their families to adjust to each other's cultures and backgrounds and to know if their marriage will survive. Rocky and Rani are trapped in a world where they are united by love but divided by families and the ultimate question is will they fit in?

crazxy-2025.title: Crazxy
crazxy-2025.synopsis: A renowned surgeon, Abhimanyu Sood is carrying ₹5 crores for a hush hush settlement that will save him from going to jail, when he gets a chilling phone call—his 16-year-old daughter, Vedica, has been kidnapped. The ransom? The exact amount he is carrying right now. Is this even a real kidnapping—or an elaborate trap?

bhool-bhulaiyaa-2007.title: Bhool Bhulaiyaa
bhool-bhulaiyaa-2007.synopsis: يقرر نراي وزوجته البقاء في منزل أجداده، دون الالتفات إلى التحذيرات بشأن الأشباح. وسرعان ما تدفعه الأحداث التي لا يمكن تفسيرها إلى استدعاء طبيب نفسي للمساعدة في حل اللغز.

kurukku-2024.title: Kurukku
kurukku-2024.synopsis: Inspector Sajan is tasked with investigating a complex double murder of a couple. However, dubious evidence and witnesses make it difficult for him to solve the case.

star-wars-the-mandalorian-and-grogu-2026.title: Star Wars: The Mandalorian and Grogu
star-wars-the-mandalorian-and-grogu-2026.titleEn: Star Wars: The Mandalorian and Grogu
star-wars-the-mandalorian-and-grogu-2026.originalTitle: Star Wars: The Mandalorian and Grogu 2026
star-wars-the-mandalorian-and-grogu-2026.synopsis: The evil Empire has fallen, and Imperial warlords remain scattered throughout the galaxy. As the fledgling New Republic works to protect everything the Rebellion fought for, they have enlisted the help of legendary Mandalorian bounty hunter Din Djarin and his young apprentice Grogu.

desert-warrior-2026.title: Desert Warrior
desert-warrior-2026.synopsis: تدور أحداث الفيلم في القرن السابع في شبه الجزيرة العربية حيث تعيش القبائل في صراعات مستمرة على السلطة ترفض الأميرة هند أن تصبح جارية لدى الإمبراطور الساساني القاسي كسرى فتهرب مع والدها الملك إلى الصحراء أثناء الهروب يلتقيان بمحارب غامض يساعدهما على النجاة لتبدأ معركة كبيرة بين القبائل العربية وجيش الإمبراطور في صراع سيغير مجرى التاريخ.

the-bus-a-french-football-mutiny-2026.title: The Bus: A French Football Mutiny
the-bus-a-french-football-mutiny-2026.titleEn: The Bus: A French Football Mutiny
the-bus-a-french-football-mutiny-2026.originalTitle: The Bus: A French Football Mutiny 2026
the-bus-a-french-football-mutiny-2026.synopsis: This documentary revisits the French football team's controversial 2010 World Cup and the bus strike that sparked global headlines and national outrage.

calle-malaga-2025.title: Calle Malaga
calle-malaga-2025.synopsis: Maria Angeles, a 79-year-old Spanish woman, lives alone in Tangier, Morocco, and enjoys her daily routine. However, her life is turned upside down when her daughter arrives from Madrid to sell the apartment in which she has always lived. Determined to stay, she does everything she can to get her home and her belongings back and, unexpectedly, rediscovers love and sensuality.

the-cavern-crimes-2025.title: The Cavern Crimes
the-cavern-crimes-2025.synopsis: An intense suspense thriller with an attractive blend of crime and mystery set in the unique historical backdrop of the Atapuerca paleontological site, home of the oldest human remains outside of Africa.

rockstar-duki-desde-el-fin-del-mundo-202.title: Rockstar Duki desde el fin del mundo
rockstar-duki-desde-el-fin-del-mundo-202.titleEn: Rockstar Duki desde el fin del mundo
rockstar-duki-desde-el-fin-del-mundo-202.originalTitle: Rockstar Duki desde el fin del mundo 2025
rockstar-duki-desde-el-fin-del-mundo-202.synopsis: Argentine trap star Duki gives an intimate look at his past and career, from early rap battles to his rise as a verified hitmaker in this documentary.

our-wildest-days-2025.title: Our Wildest Days
our-wildest-days-2025.synopsis: 20-year-old Chloe leaves her dysfunctional family to follow a group of romantic outsiders and help the forgotten of society. During her travel through a shattered Greece, she will dream, fly, and fall in love but also she’ll realize that the true rebels are always alone.

kontinental-25-2025.title: Kontinental ’25
kontinental-25-2025.synopsis: Orsolya is a bailiff in Cluj, the main city in Transylvania. One day she has to evict a homeless man from a cellar, an action with tragic consequences that triggers a moral crisis which Orsolya must weather as best she can.

bring-it-on-2000.title: Bring It On
bring-it-on-2000.synopsis: The Toro cheerleading squad from Rancho Carne High School in San Diego has got spirit, spunk, sass and a killer routine that's sure to land them the national championship trophy for the sixth year in a row. But for newly-elected team captain Torrance, the Toros' road to total cheer glory takes a shady turn when she discovers that their perfectly-choreographed routines were in fact stolen.

cafe-404-2024.title: Cafe 404
cafe-404-2024.synopsis: In the barren stretch of the motorway, Jimmy’s family diner is on the verge of extinction—until a botched drug deal drops a bag of cash into his lap. Now, Jimmy must navigate the dangerous underworld of gangsters, shady cops, and his own treacherous staff to save the business he’s clung to his entire life. With a mix of crime, thriller, and dark comedy, Jimmy and his eccentric crew—Mara, Nicko, and Abi—must outsmart the criminals closing in, all while struggling with their own growing desires for the cash. It’s a game of survival, where no one plays fair.

body-of-influence-1993.title: Body of Influence
body-of-influence-1993.synopsis: A successful psychiatrist has his world turned upside-down by the appearance of a mystery woman who cannot recall her own past...

the-good-half-2023.title: The Good Half
the-good-half-2023.synopsis: Renn Wheeland returns home to Cleveland for his mother's funeral. Once there, he forges new relationships while healing old ones, before confronting his problems and trying to face his grief.

prisons-2024.title: Prisons
prisons-2024.synopsis: When an underground marketplace of illegal activities is besieged by an army of bloodthirsty assassins, a ragtag group of criminals must band together to fight for survival.

the-biggest-fan-2025.title: The Biggest Fan
the-biggest-fan-2025.synopsis: Gérard Lanvin has an important role in a new blockbuster! Filming is about to begin in the South of France. On site, he meets Momo Zapareto, the pool boy at the house he is renting for the duration or the shoot. But Momo is a fan, a big fan… an uberfan! He has seen all his films and is soon doing all he can to make himself indispensable to his idol and the technical crew. For Gérard, the nightmare has just begun…

the-hills-have-eyes-1977.title: The Hills Have Eyes
the-hills-have-eyes-1977.synopsis: يتوجه أفراد أسرة في الطريق إلى كاليفورنيا، ولكن من سوء حظ الأسرة أن تتعطل سيارتها في منطقة مغلقة أمام الجمهور، ويسكنها مجموعة من المتوحشون العنيفون الجاهزون للهجوم.

am-lie-2001.title: Amélie
am-lie-2001.synopsis: في مقهى باريسي صغير ، تكتشف أميلي (أودري توتو) المحبوبة والخجولة بشكل مؤلم هدية لمساعدة الآخرين. سرعان ما تقضي أميلي أيامها كخاطبة ، وملاك وصي ، وخبيرة شاملة. ولكن عندما تصطدم بشخص غريب وسيم ، فهل ستجد الشجاعة لتصبح نجمة قصة حبها الخاصة؟
am-lie-2001.tagline: يمكن لشخص واحد أن يغير حياتك إلى الأبد.

balestra-2024.title: Balestra
balestra-2024.synopsis: Joanna is a competitive fencer at the end of her career who is desperate to be the world’s best. In order to gain an edge, she pursues an experimental technology, allowing her to train via lucid dreaming, where she begins a tumultuous affair with her instructor that threatens her real world marriage and her pathway to Olympic gold.

camp-crasher-2024.title: Camp Crasher
camp-crasher-2024.synopsis: في محاولة لإنقاذ رحلة تخييم نهاية العام الدراسي، تتولى أمّ عزباء مهمة سائق الحافلة وتحاول أن تثبت لابنها أنها قادرة حقًا على أن تكون والدة رائعة.

bringing-christmas-home-2023.title: Bringing Christmas Home
bringing-christmas-home-2023.synopsis: Retired military officer, now Military History professor, Caroline Upton is enlisted to assist antiques store owner, Russell Carlisle in finding the family of WWII Army officer Orin Newton before Christmas with the hope of returning precious personal artifacts – Orin’s dress uniform, medals, and a stack of love letters from his beloved Alice who waits for him back home. Epaulettes and insignia provide initial clues, though the search seems to dead end when Caroline discovers Orin was captured and listed as MIA. Caroline and Russell then search the love letters for clues as to what happened to Orin and whether he ever made it home to Alice.

bottom-of-the-water-2023.title: Bottom of the Water
bottom-of-the-water-2023.synopsis: An evil spirit that can escape the water only by possessing a living person.  The evil spirit of a child who died unjustly while waiting for his mother alone. As her younger sister Soo-ah is attacked, she and her family suffer for a long time. Her mother Geum-jeong, a spiritual shaman, was in charge of the five elements' energy. She tried to use her coexistence and antipathy to escape from the water ghost, but in the end, Soo-ah disappears into the cold, deep water, and the lives of her remaining family fall apart.  Then one day, Ga-yeong went to find her mother who suddenly disappeared. She heads to the reservoir that swallowed Soo-ah, where she discovers a mysterious body. Ga-yeong is chased by a terrible evil spirit that takes the form of her dead brother…

death-ph-d-2024.title: Death Ph.D
death-ph-d-2024.synopsis: When Ph.D. students are faced with completing their 7-year-long degree program or staying one night in an infamous haunted house to graduate early, some students pay for their decision with the ultimate sacrifice.

6000lb-shark-2024.title: 6000lb shark
6000lb-shark-2024.synopsis: With reports of enormous fat white sharks appearing off the coast of New Zealand, scientists Tom Hird and Leigh de Necker set out to find one of these behemoths and determine if the great white can reach a staggering 6,000 lbs.

the-wrath-of-becky-2023.title: The Wrath of Becky
the-wrath-of-becky-2023.synopsis: بعد مرور عامين على هروبها خلال هجوم تعرضت لها عائلتها، تسعى بيكي لإعادة بناء حياتها مجددًا برعاية امرأة مسنة تُدعى إيلينا، ولكن حينما تظهر عصابة وتهاجم المنزل، يصبح على بيكي التصدي لهم لحماية من تحب.
